claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the customer-facing semiconductor-wafer product separated into the standalone IPO company, but the core producing IP/process — CCZ crystal growth and diamond-coated-wire technology — did NOT cross ownership; it was "LICENSED to the Company, not transferred" under a "non-exclusive, perpetual, non-transferable ... royalty-free" field-of-use license, with SunEdison retaining ownership of improvements. This is a documented product-vs-process structural mismatch at closing, and it was contractually absorbed via the 24-month transition services agreement and technology joint-development/rights agreement bridging the shared substrate (gap_mitigated=yes). gap_56=0: the operations were bridged together with the people — Dr. Sadasivam and existing leadership continued via a four-year employment agreement, and the TSA/secondment/shared-lab arrangements aligned processes and organization coherently at closing.

gemini.rationale: The semiconductor-wafer product (T4) was separated into a standalone company, but the core producing IP (CCZ and diamond-coated-wire technology) did not transfer ownership; it was licensed back (T5 read-only), creating a structural gap between the product and its underlying production technology (gap_45 = 1). This gap was mitigated at closing by a transition services agreement, a patent cross-license, and a technology joint development agreement. There is no documented gap between the operational processes and the organization/people (gap_56 = 0), as existing leadership continued with the separated business.

grok.rationale: The slice states the semiconductor-wafer product/business separated into the standalone IPO company while core producing CCZ and diamond-coated-wire technology 'was LICENSED to the Company, not transferred' and remained owned by SunEdison under field-of-use limits, a documented product-vs-process ownership mismatch at closing (gap_45=1). Existing leadership continued with the separated company via the four-year CEO employment agreement and equity grants at IPO, so organization aligned with the transferred business (gap_56=0). That process gap was contractually absorbed at closing by the 24-month transition services agreement plus the patent/technology cross-license and joint-development agreements bridging the shared IP and corporate substrate.
